checkrestart_temp_file_dirs.description: List of directory prefixes to exclude temporary or volatile files (e.g., /dev/*, /tmp/*).

checkrestart_memfd_aio_sysv_pattern.description: List of patterns to exclude special memory/file mappings (e.g., memfd, aio, SysV shm).

checkrestart_x11_intel_video_pattern.description: List of patterns to exclude Intel graphics-related virtual files (e.g., /drm, /i915).
